decisions.title: Too busy to be tired
decisions.situation: Freddie says it is time for a nap. You have been awake for ages and have only inspected half the room.

choices.label: Give your eyes a short test closure
Ask Freddie to stay for a minute
Explain your position at full volume

result.title: Test extended
result.body: You wake up later. The uninspected half of the room is still there.

journal.text: I fell asleep while checking whether I needed a nap.

decisions.title: An important appointment
decisions.situation: In a lift, Freddie lets you press the button for your floor. There are so many other buttons. It seems wasteful.

choices.label: Press the right button once
Ask what the other buttons do
Press a few extra floor buttons

result.title: Express service
result.body: The lift takes you where you meant to go. You have performed a valuable public service.

journal.text: I pressed the correct lift button for Freddie.

decisions.title: A mouth with sound effects
decisions.situation: Your first loose tooth makes a clicking noise. You discover you can make it louder. Lunch is about to become a performance.

choices.label: Let everyone eat in peace
Check the wobble in a mirror
Give everyone a live demonstration

result.title: A private dental matter
result.body: You leave the tooth alone. Lunch proceeds without an audience inspecting your mouth.

journal.text: I kept my loose tooth out of the lunchtime conversation.

decisions.title: Nobody told the spy
decisions.situation: You catch Grace explaining your secret code to everyone. They claim it is fine because they have invented a second, more secret code. You have not been told it.

choices.label: Demand to inspect the new codebook
Invent a silent signal for “you are fired”
Tell everyone the first code means nothing

result.title: One unhelpful entry
result.body: The new codebook contains one word: “banana”. Grace says its meaning is classified. You add a second word meaning “tell your partner things”.

journal.text: I inspected Grace’s replacement secret code and found one word.

decisions.title: Hostile snack takeover
decisions.situation: Grace offers a plain cracker for your favourite snack. They call the cracker “rare”. There are twelve more in the packet.

choices.label: Demand two snacks for your one
Eat your snack during the sales pitch
Split yours and spare the cracker

result.title: The negotiator gets greedy
result.body: Grace nearly agrees, then notices you smiling. They withdraw the cracker and their goodwill.

journal.text: I tried to turn Grace’s snack offer into a better deal for myself.

decisions.title: Your parent knows this level
decisions.situation: You promise Freddie one last round. They sit down, watch your first attempt and say, “I used to beat this blindfolded.” This is an outrageous development.

choices.label: Stop before they can demonstrate
Agree on one round each, then stop
Demand rematches until you win

result.title: Dignity preserved
result.body: You keep your promise and turn it off. Freddie seems more pleased about that than any old high score.

journal.text: I stopped a game when I had promised Freddie I would.

decisions.title: A complaint from past you
decisions.situation: You find a childhood letter addressed to yourself. It says, “If you are not a dinosaur by thirteen, you have ruined everything.” There is a drawing of the expected dinosaur.

choices.label: Make a tail out of socks and deliver a roar
Write a formal rejection on the back
Destroy the evidence

result.title: Partial compliance
result.body: The tail falls off during your first turn. You add “technical difficulties” beneath the original demand and draw yourself with better knees.

journal.text: I answered a childhood demand to become a dinosaur by making a sock tail.

decisions.title: That is definitely your voice

choices.label: Request a less insulting goose
Offer one actual round of washing-up
Send an impression of them volunteering instead

result.title: A second audition
result.body: Freddie sends a deeper version. Now you sound like a goose with a cold. You both give up trying to discuss the dishes.

journal.text: I demanded a better impression after Freddie impersonated me in a voice note.

decisions.title: Forwarded with absolutely no evidence

choices.label: Ask whether anyone actually knows
Mute it and step away
Forward it for a reaction

result.title: An inconvenient question
result.body: Nobody produces evidence. The conversation changes topic with suspicious speed.

journal.text: I challenged a rumour in a group chat.

decisions.title: Apparently this was cool

choices.label: Ask what it reminds them of
Trade one song each
Give a brutally concise review

result.title: Before they were your parent
result.body: The story is better than expected. You learn something new about Freddie.

journal.text: I listened to Freddie’s old music and the story behind it.

decisions.title: Sent to the group

Admit you meant a different chat
Explain that autocorrect meant “adorable”

result.title: A successful retreat
result.body: You miss the replies and spend the afternoon doing something else. The message remains embarrassing; you stop watching it happen.

journal.text: I muted a group after sending an insulting message to it.

result.title: One less pile
result.body: The laundry is still laundry. At least it is now folded.

journal.text: I stopped comparing my evening to everyone else’s highlights.

decisions.title: The lost hand

choices.label: Carry it to reception
Leave it upright on the bench
Ask around for anyone missing a hand

result.title: Please wave if this is yours

decisions.title: Before answering immediately

Say you need a short break
Deliver the sharp reply

result.body: The pause gives you time to separate the question from your tiredness. You answer the thing that was actually asked.

journal.text: I paused before answering sharply when I was tired.

Fill every bit of the day

result.title: A useful day with an ending
result.body: You use some energy without treating all of it as a resource that must be exhausted.

journal.text: I paced a good day instead of filling every available moment.
